meaning:
ἐπι-πορεύομαι
[in LXX: Lev.26:33 (אָחַר), Eze.39:14 (עָבַר), Ep. Jer.6:2, 2Ma.2:28, 3Ma.1:4 * ;]
to travel, journey to: before πρός, with accusative of person(s), Luk.8:4.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: When a great multitude came together, and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable.
